personality_one_liner: A warm, energetic, and intuitive F&B marketplace that uses expressive amber tones and adaptive tonal surfaces to make gig work feel empowering and approachable.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use nested tonal containers rather than hard shadows. Avoid cramped layouts by properly spacing edge margins.

do's: Use over the hero image in Job Detail screens.
Use for the sticky bottom container that holds 'Ambil Shift'.
Apply to bottom tabs when content scrolls behind them.
dont's: Don't use glass everywhere (avoid on dense job cards).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Material You / Expressive personality strictly. DO NOT use standard Material 3 indigo. Rely heavily on tonal containers and adaptive colors using the provided amber/orange F&B palette.
No pure white cards with hard drop shadows. Depth must be created through tonal surfaces (surfaceSecondary, brandTertiary) and spacing.

Implement the Sticky CTA pattern exactly: Wrap 'Ambil Shift' and 'Check In Sekarang' in a fixed absolute container at the bottom over the scroll view, using glassmorphism (expo-blur) or solid surface to keep it reachable within 3 taps without scrolling.
For Attendance Check-In, integrate map/geofence status visually on top and a camera preview framed clearly on the bottom. Add haptics 'notificationSuccess' upon check-in completion.

For the 'Buat Loker' form, ensure labels are above inputs (never floating), use large touch targets (pill-shaped segmented controls) for selecting skills (Barista, Kasir, etc.). Submit CTA must stick to the bottom above the keyboard using KeyboardAvoidingView.

Always apply a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over any hero background images before layering text (like in Job Detail screens). Ensure contrast is AA readable.
Default language is Bahasa Indonesia. Keep tone casual but professional (e.g. 'Ambil Shift', 'Loker Terdekat', 'Dompet', 'Beri Nilai').
